Theorem
[Compactness for solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0400 1. appD:D.34\group Ricci Flow Compactness

Let $(\mathcal M_k,g_k(t),O_k)$ be complete pointed Ricci flows on a common interval $(\alpha ,\omega )$ containing zero. If their curvatures are uniformly bounded and $\operatorname {inj}_{g_k(0)}(O_k)\geq \iota _0>0$, then a subsequence converges in the smooth pointed Cheeger--Gromov sense to a complete pointed Ricci flow on $(\alpha ,\omega )$.
